task8_decision.recommendation_rationale: Not A (stop at 2M): the population/identity-key/storage picture is more favorable than initially framed, and an adjudicated native 10M baseline already exists at zero additional infrastructure cost to pair against. Not C (prepare full144 immediately): would commit ~60x the compute against an unbudgeted GPU cost (no measurement exists) and an unresolved representation-validity question, before the native full144 pipeline even exists -- violates the requirement that scale decisions rest on measured resource requirements. B retires the GPU-throughput and checkpoint-validity gaps at a scale cheap enough to redo if unfavorable, while producing the first real matched-N scientific comparison.
